DEC-001.description: Version-controlled policies make the public maintenance contract reviewable and auditable.

alternatives: Maintain governance only in external documentation

DEC-002.description: Read-only import plus artifact hashes preserves trust in the migration record.
DEC-002.title: Import source artifacts read-only with provenance

DEC-003.description: A durable evidence record keeps release verification reviewable alongside requirements.
DEC-003.title: Record release evidence in the intent graph

DEC-004.description: Traversing typed edges in both directions exposes outcome context, implementation tasks, proof obligations, and evidence without inferring semantic changes.
DEC-004.title: Use deterministic bidirectional graph traversal

DEC-005.description: A public, repeatable quality matrix makes validation visible to contributors and catches regressions before merge.

DEC-005.title: Run a minimal GitHub Actions quality matrix

DEC-006.description: JSON-only packs provide consistent defaults without executing code or weakening the trusted checker boundary.

alternatives: Embed policy behavior in hard-coded workflow prompts

DEC-006.title: Keep policies declarative and local

DEC-007.description: Explicit project authorization and digest pinning make external execution reviewable while preserving graph ownership in the core.

alternatives: Discover installed Python checker packages automatically

DEC-007.title: Use manifest-pinned JSON subprocesses

DEC-008.description: A narrow JSON protocol keeps graph mutation, policy resolution, proof execution, and evidence persistence inside Intent Kit while giving agents useful local work capabilities.

alternatives: Grant agents unrestricted shell access to the project
Expose the graph JSON directly for agents to edit

DEC-008.title: Use a project-scoped Agent Computer protocol
